description: This file contains the implementation of the StreamPubSubImpl class, which implements the IStreamPubSub interface to manage publishing and subscribing to streams in the Orleans streaming framework. It handles registration, unregistration, subscription management, and querying for producers and consumers for specific streams.

classes.name: StreamPubSubImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IStreamPubSub that manages stream publisher-subscriber interactions, supporting both explicit and implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: StreamPubSubImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing explicit and implicit pub/sub components with null checks.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a stream, aggregating results from explicit and implicit pub/sub components.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer for a stream, routing to implicit or explicit pub/sub based on subscriber type.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of producers for a stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of consumers for a stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Gets all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription ID for a consumer on a stream.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Fauts a given subscription, handling errors for specific subscriptions.
